title: Tier resolution accepts kind:herding — cell purpose routes, gather keeps the default model
action: Per D1/D3: normalize_tier_value accepts {kind:"herding"} (no other required fields; unknown extra fields dropped, same trim rules as cli). Add Resolved::Herding to the Resolved enum. resolve_tier: a herding-shaped slot with cell purpose (for_gather=false) returns Resolved::Herding; with gather purpose (for_gather=true) returns the RUNTIME DEFAULT model for that slot (default_models(runtime), e.g. claude generation -> sonnet; a runtime whose default slot is null returns Budget) — the exact inverse of cli's branch at models.rs:301 which refuses cell and serves gather. resolve_advisor: a herding-shaped advisor slot is not meaningful — treat as None (advisor never executes cells). Tests in drivers/tests.rs: normalize accepts/round-trips the shape; cell purpose -> Herding; gather purpose -> default model value; codex runtime gather -> Budget (null default); malformed ({kind:"herding", command:...} etc.) falls through existing rules unchanged; existing cli tests untouched.

truths: {kind:herding} + gather purpose resolves to the runtime default model, never Herding, never a refusal
